# openssl — 2002 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 5 openssl CVEs of 2002 are in `data/cve/vendors/openssl/2002.jsonl`.

### CVE-2002-0656
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-07-31 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 40347: Apache mod_ssl OpenSSL < 0.9.6d / < 0.9.7-beta2 - 'openssl-too-open.c' SSL2 KEY_ARG Overflow (remote/unix, 2002-09-17, verified=0)

Buffer overflows in OpenSSL 0.9.6d and earlier, and 0.9.7-beta2 and earlier, allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via (1) a large client master key in SSL2 or (2) a large session ID in SSL3.

### CVE-2002-0659
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2002-07-31 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 23199: OpenSSL - ASN.1 Parsing (remote/multiple, 2003-10-09, verified=1)

The ASN1 library in OpenSSL 0.9.6d and earlier, and 0.9.7-beta2 and earlier, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service via invalid encodings.
